notes: Read by scripts/check-deps.mjs and by the quarterly pass in .claude/skills/polaris-tech-lifecycle/references/dependency-audit.md. NEVER read by anything under src/ at runtime: npm majors publish no end-of-life dates, and which major an install runs is fixed by its build, so this is a repo fact rather than a per-install monitoring signal. targetMajor is the major this repo intends to be on; check-deps fails when the installed major is below it.

npm.name: express
npm.note: Routing is validated at boot, not per request. tests/unit/routerBoots.test.ts guards the :param(regex) form that crashed production once.

npm.name: prisma
npm.note: Moves as one version with @prisma/client and @prisma/adapter-pg.

npm.name: zod
npm.note: Issue shape feeds the API's 400 bodies, so an error-shape change is an API-contract change.

npm.name: pg-boss
npm.note: Queue schema; a major can require a queue migration.

npm.name: happy-dom
npm.note: Mis-parses <option selected>; DOM tests must set selection in JS after insertion.

npm.name: @types/node
npm.note: A Node-pin family member. Moves with engines.node and every other Node declaration site, NOT on Dependabot's schedule.

go.name: github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v3
go.note: Reads OS internals for the sample streams - a bump can change what a metric means on one platform and not another. Verify one Linux and one Windows agent before shipping.

overrides.name: @hono/node-server
overrides.reason: Prisma 7 dev-server tooling; floored rather than taking npm audit's suggested Prisma major downgrade.
